name: Mission Flayon
source:
The leader has called the Vanguard team over. According to him, he has a little mission that lasts almost the whole day outside the Guild Hall. Unfortunately, only Flayon is available to take it since the other 3 have other important business to do. Will he survive the day or die trying?

[from [url=https://flayon-birthday-project.itch.io/mission-flayon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
队长召集了先锋小队。据他说，有个小任务，需要在公会大厅外花上几乎一整天。不巧的是，另外三人都有要事，只有Flayon能接下任务。他能活着度过这一天，还是会在拼命尝试中丧命？

[摘自[url=https://flayon-birthday-project.itch.io/mission-flayon]itch.io[/url]]
